title: Base Sixty-Four (Encode The Line)
style: math-tech electronic, modular synth, glitch hop drums, vocoded male lead, female harmony, 96 BPM, zynthio math foundations, precise, encoded
lyrics:
[Intro — binary kick, modular synth bleeps]
(spoken) Base sixty-four. Encode the line.

[Verse 1]
Six bits at a time, packed tight
A through Z, a through z, plus and slash in sight
Pad with equals when the bytes don't align
Forty padding bytes, the count divine

[Pre-Chorus]
Encode, decode, the wire stays clean
No binary leaks through the text-only stream

[Chorus]
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — ENCODE THE LINE
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — SIX BITS AT A TIME
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — EQUAL SIGNS PAD THE END
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — THE STREAM TRANSCENDS

[Verse 2]
Thirty-three percent overhead in the wire
Three bytes in, four chars out the choir
MIME and JWT and data URLs sing
Every image, every token, every secret thing

[Bridge — spoken]
A equals zero. B equals one.
Slash equals sixty-three. Plus is sixty-two.
The alphabet is fixed. The padding is true.

[Final Chorus]
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — THE TEXT-SAFE FLIGHT
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — EVERY BYTE IS ALRIGHT
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — ZYNTHIO MATH RUNS DEEP
BASE SIXTY-FOUR — THE LINE WE KEEP
